# testing_x_soft_delete_property (Data Source)

XSoftDeleteProperty DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "testing_x_soft_delete_property" "my_xsoftdeleteproperty" {
  id = "...my_id..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `non_soft_delete_property_request_and_response` (String) Non x-speakeasy-soft-delete-property that should remain configurable.
- `non_soft_delete_property_response_only` (String) Non x-speakeasy-soft-delete-property that should remain as read-only.
- `soft_delete_property` (String) Has x-speakeasy-soft-delete-property and should have these intended behaviors:
For managed resources: should not be present in schema and should be checked to automatically remove resource in Read method.
For data resources: should remain present in schema (practitioners may wish to fetch these and optionally filter out).
